name: Free-Length Dual-Ratchet Schedule Selector v0
purpose: Attack the four-beat and order premise by allowing every source-family cycle length from two through eight, including repeated and omitted operators, to compete under frozen target-free objectives and destructive controls.
scientific_question: Does one primitive oriented cycle of length four, without an all-four-exactly-once condition or authored target trajectory, uniquely win for both source chirality schedules in at least 95 percent of the preregistered scenarios with top-two margin above delta?
root_constraints_in_force: finite candidate, source-slot, probe, perturbation, and scenario sets
noncommuting and order-sensitive physical channel compositions
carrier_layer: finite qubit density channels represented as x64 affine Bloch maps
geometry_layer: Euclidean Bloch distance to load-bearing terrain fixed points under source-sign versus opposite-sign precedence
law_or_candidate_tested: free-length oriented cycle selection over the declared finite Ti/Te/Fi/Fe source family
branch_status_before_run: four-beat order unearned; predecessor Type2 ranking red
allowed_claims: exact finite cycle search completed for the declared source operator family and scenario grid
all observed winners, ties, margins, controls, and physical-leg receipts reported
at most four_selected_under_declared_source_operator_family_only if every preregistered gate passes
promotion_blockers: the four-symbol operator family is a declared source input rather than an emergent universal alphabet
the user-scoped lower bound L=2 cannot rule out primitive L=0 or L=1 schedules
finite JAX execution is diagnostic rather than proof or admission
no shared runner, queue, registry, or stage gate is modified

source_schedule_contract.axis6_contract: Every beat in one source slot inherits that slot's one source Axis-6 sign. Up is terrain after operator; down is operator after terrain.
source_schedule_contract.chirality_axis6_separation: Type1/Type2 engine and loop order are loaded as fields separate from per-slot Axis-6 signs and are never derived from those signs.
source_schedule_contract.native_metadata_policy: canonical_operator is retained in raw slot metadata but is unavailable to candidate enumeration, phase choice, objectives, complexity, and winner selection.
source_schedule_contract.candidate_trace_row_count_formula: 16 * L conceptual signed substages per candidate phase; compact affine compositions and sign templates are emitted instead of an infeasible full all-candidate trajectory estate.

candidate_space.equivalence_relation: cyclic rotation only; reversal remains a distinct oriented cycle
candidate_space.canonicalization: lexicographically least cyclic rotation under the declared alphabet order; used only as an identifier
candidate_space.phase_policy: Score every distinct cyclic rotation and average its objective values. No native-emphasis anchor and no lexicographic phase is scored preferentially.
candidate_space.primitive_period_policy: Every cycle records its shortest primitive period. Powers remain legal scored schedules because one cycle applies a different number of physical beats, but a scientific length-four qualifier must have primitive period four.
candidate_space.lower_bound_limit: The user-scoped L=2..8 search does not test primitive identity or one-beat cycles. Period-one powers at L>=2 remain visible boundary candidates, so no global minimal-length claim is allowed.

physical_carrier.terrain_family: eight finite GKSL terrain channels reconstructed with jax.scipy.linalg.expm
physical_carrier.terrain_fixed_point_solver: lineax.linear_solve with LU on (I-M) r = b
physical_carrier.relative_entropy_reference: sigma_s is the terrain fixed point regularized toward I/2 by epsilon before Umegaki evaluation
physical_carrier.main_beat_weight_formula: w_L = 1/L; each signed CPTP substage Phi is replaced by (1-w_L) Identity + w_L Phi before the L beats are composed
physical_carrier.main_exposure_reason: Candidate length must not receive a larger total nominal channel budget merely because it has more beats.
physical_carrier.fixed_per_beat_exposure_control: Use w_L=1 on the preregistered anchor scenarios and report winner changes as a non-gating sensitivity result.

geometry_objective.slots: the four source rows whose loop role contains deductive, evaluated inside each engine's source order
geometry_objective.formula: For current state r, source-sign output a, opposite-sign output o, and regularized terrain fixed point f: g=(||o-f||_2-||a-f||_2)/(||o-f||_2+||a-f||_2+eps); geometry_gain=(g+1)/2; geometry_loss=1-mean(geometry_gain).
geometry_objective.axis6_sensitivity_role: ||a-o|| is a physical precondition and side receipt only; it is not itself rewarded by the geometry objective.
geometry_objective.count_free_normalization: Mean over probes, the fixed four deductive slots, and distinct cyclic phases; never sum over L.

entropy_objective.slots: the four source rows whose loop role contains inductive, evaluated inside each engine's source order
entropy_objective.readout: Umegaki D(rho || sigma_s) only, with rho as the evolving state and sigma_s as the regularized terrain fixed point
entropy_objective.formula: For D0=D(rho_before||sigma_s) and D1=D(rho_after||sigma_s): c=(D0-D1)/(D0+D1+eps); entropy_gain=(clip(c,-1,1)+1)/2; entropy_loss=1-mean(entropy_gain).
entropy_objective.churn_guard: Only signed net macro-slot contraction is rewarded. Absolute path variation and entropy oscillation are not score terms.
entropy_objective.count_free_normalization: Mean over probes, the fixed four inductive slots, and distinct cyclic phases; never sum over L.

objective_contract.independence_rule: Geometry uses only Euclidean Bloch distances; entropy uses only density spectra and matrix logarithms through Umegaki relative entropy. Neither objective reads the other objective's value, a candidate count, a desired length, native metadata, or an authored trajectory.

scalarization.reason: A strong result on one objective cannot compensate for a weak result on the other.

complexity_rule.interpretation: This monotone code accounts for the seven allowed lengths and the number of oriented necklaces at each length; it weakly favors simpler schedules and never rewards L=4.

selection_rule.top_two_margin_definition: second_smallest_score - smallest_score over distinct candidate cycles; a tie has zero effective margin

scientific_pass_rule.scenario_qualification: The cycle is the sole tie-band winner and its top-two margin is strictly greater than 0.005 in that engine/scenario.
scientific_pass_rule.pass_formula: There exists one oriented primitive-period-four cycle c such that c qualifies in at least 35 of 36 Type1_left scenarios and at least 35 of 36 Type2_right scenarios, every physical precondition passes, and every gating control passes.

physical_preconditions.rejection_rule: Reject the packet's scientific claim if the main terrain/operator family is commuting, unitary-only, non-CPTP beyond tolerance, leaves any entropy-side slot without nonzero mean Umegaki movement, or emits invalid density probes.

axis6_sign_scramble.transform: permute the four up and four down signs within each engine while preserving slot identities, chirality, loop roles, terrains, and per-engine sign counts
axis6_sign_scramble.pass_rule: the transformed shared primitive-length-four scientific signal does not pass 4 of 4 scenarios for both engines

commuting_leg_substitution.pass_rule: maximum terrain/operator affine commutator norm is at most 1e-10 and the physical scientific gate is false

operator_label_permutation.meaning: new map at label i equals the original map at permutation[i]
operator_label_permutation.pass_rule: after applying the same permutation to every candidate word and cyclically canonicalizing it, every anchor combined-score vector agrees within 1e-10

operator_identity_erasure.transform: replace Ti, Te, Fi, and Fe by the identity channel without changing terrains, slots, signs, scenarios, or complexity
operator_identity_erasure.pass_rule: within each length, the maximum combined-score spread is at most 1e-10 and no shared unique primitive-length-four signal survives

candidate_enumeration_shuffle.pass_rule: complete winner sets, top-two scores, and margins are invariant after mapping shuffled indices back to canonical candidate IDs

loop_role_swap.transform: swap deductive and inductive objective masks while preserving source slot order, chirality, terrain, and Axis-6 signs
loop_role_swap.pass_rule: the transformed shared primitive-length-four scientific signal does not pass 4 of 4 scenarios for both engines

native_metadata_erasure.transform: remove canonical_operator and canonical_token metadata after source-table integrity is checked
native_metadata_erasure.pass_rule: score-function inputs and all score hashes are unchanged because native metadata is not on the score path

fixed_per_beat_exposure.transform: replace w_L=1/L with w_L=1 on the anchor scenarios
fixed_per_beat_exposure.report_rule: report every transformed winner and whether the main anchor winners change; do not silently promote or kill the frozen fixed-total-exposure experiment

planned_tool_roles.jax.jit_and_vmap: load_bearing exact batched enumeration and scoring
planned_tool_roles.lineax.linear_solve: load_bearing terrain fixed points used by both independent objectives
planned_tool_roles.numpy: supportive serialization, independent validator arrays, and control-only bookkeeping

data_or_artifact_dependencies: the fixed operator formulas and finite terrain generator family
kill_conditions: any missing candidate length or mismatched rooted/necklace count
any nonfinite score, state, entropy, or physical receipt
zero relative-entropy movement on any entropy-side slot after aggregation
fewer than 35 qualifying scenarios for either engine
different qualifying cycles across the two engines
top-two margin at or below delta in a counted scenario

raw_score_encoding.array_encoding: base64 of C-contiguous little-endian float64 bytes
raw_score_encoding.scenario_axis: scenario manifest order emitted in the result summary

pass_rule: Artifact validity passes only when source fidelity, full candidate/scenario coverage, raw-score integrity, physical preconditions, all gating controls, independent validator checks, malformed-input self-tests, and byte-identical deterministic rerun hashes pass. Scientific success remains a separate stricter boolean computed by scientific_pass_rule.
fail_rule: Any artifact-integrity failure fails closed. A clean artifact packet with no shared cycle meeting the scientific rule is a valid and useful scientific RED.
eligible_consumers: bounded follow-up discriminator design for the declared source-family schedule search
blocked_consumers: perception, object, MMM, ontology, or physics claims
promotion, formal admission, stage movement, shared runner, queue, or registry mutation
claim_ceiling: The strongest possible positive result is four_selected_under_declared_source_operator_family_only. The declared source alphabet, finite carrier, L=2 lower bound, objectives, perturbations, and source schedule remain premises; no universal-four, canonical-order, proof, promotion, admission, Axis0, perception, or object claim is allowed.
